name: River Development Agent Controlled Operation Execution Lifecycle Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED OPERATION EXECUTION LIFECYCLE FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-277 consumes only the exact DEV-276 controlled operation execution receipt result contract.
DEV-277 denies lifecycle establishment when the DEV-276 predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, missing a receipt, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required evidence.
DEV-277 creates deterministic lifecycle data only.
DEV-277 does not execute or re-execute an operation.
DEV-277 does not retry execution.
DEV-277 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-277 does not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-277 preserves the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-277 preserves predecessor provenance, execution evidence, and receipt evidence.
DEV-277 does not expand execution scope.
DEV-277 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-277 does not modify repository content.
DEV-277 does not delete repository content.
DEV-277 does not stage repository changes.
DEV-277 does not commit.
DEV-277 does not push.
DEV-277 does not deploy.
DEV-277 does not access secrets.
DEV-277 does not perform arbitrary shell execution.
DEV-277 does not perform network execution.
DEV-277 does not perform external side effects.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
A future explicit controlled execution completion boundary is required before downstream progression.
